seed_scope: numpy.random.seed and torch.manual_seed; deterministic kernels not enforced

model.name: BS-RoFormer ZFTurbo MUSDB18-HQ pretrained
model.latency_reason: Offline bidirectional attention and overlap-add use future samples; context length is not a measured causal latency
model.timing_scope: sum of synchronized model forwards across all chunks and TTA, including in-model STFT + neural mask + ISTFT; excludes loading, file I/O, padding, transfers and overlap-add
model.processing_timing_scope: all chunks and TTA, CPU preparation, padding, device transfers, neural inference and overlap-add; excludes checkpoint loading and file I/O

source_provenance.training_data_statement: Publisher says trained on MUSDB18HQ; exact training/validation list not supplied

model.head_selection_scope: inference only; pretrained vocal head and shared trunk unchanged; source checkpoint remains unmodified

stream.rolling_window_padding: zero before start and after explicit EOF; internal separator padding may also apply
stream.timing_scope: rolling window creation, synchronized separator call and output crop; excludes input reads/push copy, model load/warmup, sink writes and sleep
stream.virtual_scheduler: single serial worker; audio input released at packet sample boundary / fs; finish=max(input_release, previous_finish)+measured_compute
stream.deadline_definition: available packet audio-clock time + nominal emit period; EOF flush is a separate burst and is excluded from steady-state
stream.availability_definition: sample interval boundaries; first sample is index output_start; final sample precedes output_end boundary by 1/fs

quality_whole_clip_includes_startup_and_.preservation_diagnostic_scope: unaligned raw waveform error; no gain fitting; interpret especially on original-vocal identity inputs

protocol.alignment: none; caller must preserve time alignment

quality_full_real_context_steady_state.preservation_diagnostic_scope: unaligned raw waveform error; no gain fitting; interpret especially on original-vocal identity inputs

protocol.alignment: none; caller must preserve time alignment

steady_state_quality_interval_convention: start inclusive, end exclusive; concatenate non-EOF emissions with zero left padding; a shared interval across different configurations is not enforced
limitations: No audio hardware, callback, driver or input/output device latency was measured.
Offline model is recomputed for each emitted block; it is not converted to a causal architecture.
Non-overlapping output crops have no crossfade; listening must check boundary artifacts.
The selected clip starts with zero history and ends with explicit EOF, not real song continuation.
Per-emission times are one short run, not a repeated timing benchmark.
SI-SDR is the project whole-segment metric, not the original paper SDR protocol.
